verdicts.reason: No full Cold War: trade hit a record and Biden and Xi met in Bali in Nov 2022. But 2022 brought the Fourth Taiwan Strait Crisis after Pelosi's visit (PLA encirclement drills, China suspended military and climate dialogue) and the sweeping Oct 2022 chip export controls. The feared confrontation materialised in part.

evidence.title: 2022 visit by Nancy Pelosi to Taiwan (Wikipedia)
evidence.shows: Visit 2-3 Aug; PLA encirclement drills 4-11 Aug ('Fourth Taiwan Strait Crisis'); China suspended US military dialogue and climate cooperation.

evidence.title: US export controls on advanced computing and semiconductors to China (Wikipedia)
evidence.shows: Oct 2022 controls: 'most expansive export control action in decades'.
